findings.title: Preflight authorizes malformed and hostile requests
findings.evidence: Direct reproduction authorized permissions={} and requests carrying credential values under arbitrary or nested fields. Invoking the CLI without --request returns ok=false but omits authorized=null, next_board_status=BLOCKED, and stop_condition.

findings.title: Writer can bypass the branch and production fences
findings.evidence: actions/checkout preserves the contents:write credential. Claude is allowed Bash(node:*), Bash(npm:*), and Bash(npx:*), permitting nested child-process git commands before the later scope and branch checks. It can therefore commit and push arbitrary files or main; immutable candidate evidence does not prove branch protection blocks this.

findings.title: Selected-item scope is not enforced
findings.evidence: The preflight selects an item, but post-write enforcement only checks that paths are under control-plane/. A writer authorized for ACP-002 can modify ACP-003's board record or implementation, and git add control-plane will commit it.

findings.title: Retry ceiling is declarative only
findings.evidence: WRITER_MAX_RETRIES is supplied to the request but never enforced against GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT. A rerun can invoke Claude again against the same authorized ancestor SHA despite max_retries=0.

findings.title: BASELINE condition 11 is cosmetic
findings.evidence: conditionJudgeReadOnly checks only board.execution_policy.judge_must_be_read_only === true; it does not inspect any judge job's actual repository permissions.

findings.title: Named reverse proofs do not prove unsafe authorization
findings.evidence: In-memory reproduction of the condition 1, 3, and 6 mutants produced their locally mutated check as true while overall ok remained false and authorized remained null (failed conditions [2], [2], and [1,2]). The committed tests assert only the individual check, so their claims that a writer would start are not genuine reverse proofs.

summary: Blocking failures exist in fail-closed input handling, credential containment, branch/production fencing, retry enforcement, item scoping, and mutation proofs. Kernel check passed. The required full test command could not be independently completed because the enforced read-only filesystem rejected its temporary mutant files with EROFS.
